tracksIndexes.name: tracks_album_id_idx

finalConsumer.query: Entity-scoped findings read starts from tracks.album_id = ?.

tracksIndexes.structuralRationale: Indexed graph-pointer equality bounds album pages and backfill work to one album slice.

tracksIndexes.name: tracks_label_id_idx

finalConsumer.query: Indexed tracks.label_id scans fan out a label ruling only to its tracks.

tracksIndexes.structuralRationale: Serves label graph pages, label-scoped projection repair, and metadata linking without scanning the catalogue.

tracksIndexes.name: tracks_is_catalogue_idx

finalConsumer.query: Catalogue-filtered hub lane uses is_catalogue = 1.

tracksIndexes.structuralRationale: Materializes the catalogue anti-join as a shrinking predicate-free catalogue slice for consumers that only need membership.

tracksIndexes.name: tracks_fresh_catalogue_idx

finalConsumer.query: Fresh catalogue window filters is_catalogue and release_date, ordered by release_date DESC, track_id DESC.

tracksIndexes.structuralRationale: Visible leading equality plus date range and tie-break order avoids a catalogue-wide temporary sort.

tracksIndexes.name: tracks_catalogue_active_track_id_idx

finalConsumer.query: Stale active-catalogue batch filters is_catalogue = 1 and dismissed_at IS NULL, ordered by track_id.

tracksIndexes.structuralRationale: Supports bounded active-catalogue walks without sorting the full live catalogue.

tracksIndexes.name: tracks_catalogue_ear_idx

finalConsumer.query: ear lens filters active catalogue with non-null nearest_finding_score and orders score DESC, track_id DESC.

tracksIndexes.structuralRationale: Aligns both active predicates and the Ear ranking order for a reverse bounded walk.

tracksIndexes.name: tracks_catalogue_capture_idx

finalConsumer.query: capture lens filters active catalogue with non-null capture_priority and orders priority DESC, track_id DESC.

tracksIndexes.structuralRationale: Aligns active-catalogue predicates with the metered capture ranking order.

tracksIndexes.name: tracks_vendor_worklist_idx

finalConsumer.query: Apple, Deezer, and Beatport catalogue worklists filter is_catalogue and order capture_priority DESC, track_id DESC.

tracksIndexes.structuralRationale: Metadata work includes dismissed rows, so it needs a separate ordered catalogue worklist without dismissed_at.

tracksIndexes.name: tracks_funnel_scan_idx

finalConsumer.query: Single conditional aggregate over catalogue stages is required to use this covering index.

tracksIndexes.structuralRationale: Covers every funnel arm so the full scan reads a narrow index rather than rows containing large audio/vector storage.

tracksIndexes.name: tracks_release_date_idx

finalConsumer.query: The exact entity-fresh, public findings, public records, year-grouping, projected keyset/NULL-zone, and filtered-search release-date consumers retain a bounded release-date driver.

tracksIndexes.structuralRationale: Retain the narrow release-date index because the entity-scoped freshness reads need its lower write-independent traversal cost to stay inside the hosted 2x latency budget; the wider composite remains load-bearing for stable keyset pagination.

tracksIndexes.name: tracks_release_date_track_id_idx

finalConsumer.query: The projected hub reads an exact two-column row-value suffix and an explicit null-date suffix through this index.

tracksIndexes.structuralRationale: Provides the strict ordered suffix needed for stable public hub pagination without a corpus walk or temporary tie sort.

tracksIndexes.name: tracks_bpm_idx

finalConsumer.query: BPM bounds compile to bare tracks.bpm >= ? and tracks.bpm <= ? predicates.

tracksIndexes.structuralRationale: Keeps the optional archive-wide BPM range filter seekable.

tracksIndexes.name: tracks_nearest_finding_score_idx

finalConsumer.query: The Ear filters is_catalogue, dismissed_at, and nearest_finding_score before ordering score and track_id; tracks_catalogue_ear_idx serves the exact shape.

tracksIndexes.structuralRationale: Drop in the final contraction: no final query uses the singleton shape, while the exact Ear consumer is fully covered by tracks_catalogue_ear_idx.

tracksIndexes.name: tracks_capture_priority_idx

finalConsumer.query: Apple, Deezer, and Beatport catalogue worklists use is_catalogue plus nullable capture_priority and track_id ordering, all carried by tracks_vendor_worklist_idx.

tracksIndexes.structuralRationale: Drop in the final contraction: tracks_vendor_worklist_idx is a full composite whose is_catalogue prefix and capture_priority/track_id suffix serve the exact nullable-priority vendor reads, leaving the singleton shadowed.

tracksIndexes.name: tracks_source_audio_attempted_at_idx

finalConsumer.query: Rolling 24-hour ledger filters source_audio_attempted_at >= cutoff.

tracksIndexes.structuralRationale: A range seek skips the unattempted majority and bounds the budget-brake read to its recent window.

tracksIndexes.name: tracks_capture_verification_verified_at_idx

finalConsumer.query: Attention queue filters capture_verification = 'mismatch' and orders capture_verified_at ASC.

tracksIndexes.structuralRationale: Combines mismatch equality with attention ordering; it also supports the null-verification backfill queue.

tracksIndexes.name: tracks_isrc_idx

finalConsumer.query: Batch ISRC resolution uses tracks.isrc IN (...) equality probes.

tracksIndexes.structuralRationale: Supports crawler idempotence and public identity resolution; it intentionally remains non-unique because duplicate ISRCs are representable.

tracksIndexes.name: tracks_anchor_queue_idx
tracksIndexes.partialPredicate: spotify_uri IS NULL AND isrc IS NOT NULL

finalConsumer.query: Anchor-pending gauge counts unanchored rows that have an ISRC.

tracksIndexes.structuralRationale: Small partial index represents the fillable anchor slice and shrinks as Spotify anchors land.

tracksIndexes.name: tracks_mb_recording_id_queue_idx
tracksIndexes.partialPredicate: mb_recording_id IS NULL AND mb_recording_id_attempted_at IS NULL

finalConsumer.query: Backfill reads unfilled, unattempted recording-MBID rows in track_id order.

tracksIndexes.structuralRationale: Indexes the derived shrinking worklist rather than the whole catalogue.

tracksIndexes.name: tracks_mb_recording_id_idx

finalConsumer.query: MBID identity key resolves through tracks.mb_recording_id equality.

tracksIndexes.structuralRationale: Filled MBID values are a growing lookup domain and may be ambiguous, requiring a non-unique value index.

tracksIndexes.name: tracks_discogs_release_idx

finalConsumer.query: Discogs facts worklist starts from rows with in_release_id IS NOT NULL and groups by album.

tracksIndexes.structuralRationale: Indexes only the small resolved-release subset eligible for the facts sweep.

tracksIndexes.name: tracks_spotify_uri_idx

finalConsumer.query: Spotify URI identity key uses an equality probe and participates in the track_id OR Spotify URI resolution path.

tracksIndexes.structuralRationale: Avoids blob-heavy full scans for public identity misses while preserving ambiguous collisions.

tracksIndexes.name: tracks_deezer_track_id_idx

finalConsumer.query: Deezer identity key resolves through tracks.deezer_track_id equality.

tracksIndexes.structuralRationale: Filled Deezer IDs are a growing non-unique identity lookup domain.

tracksIndexes.name: tracks_artist_edges_backfill_queue_idx

finalConsumer.query: Name-fold graph backfill walks unattempted rows in track_id order.

tracksIndexes.structuralRationale: Indexes the stamp-gated shrinking candidate walk; the anti-join portion uses track_artists indexes.

tracksIndexes.name: tracks_artist_credits_backfill_queue_idx
tracksIndexes.partialPredicate: artist_credits_backfilled_at IS NULL AND artist_edges_backfilled_at IS NOT NULL

finalConsumer.query: MB-credit sweep walks slice-0-stamped but credit-unattempted rows in track_id order.

tracksIndexes.structuralRationale: Precisely fronts the residual zero-match credit-recovery queue.

tracksIndexes.name: tracks_embed_queue_idx
tracksIndexes.partialPredicate: source_audio_key IS NOT NULL AND has_embedding = 0

finalConsumer.query: embed kind literal predicate matches the partial index and reads the bounded queue.

tracksIndexes.structuralRationale: Derived queue shrinks as embeddings land; literal mirror predicate is required for SQLite partial-index eligibility.

tracksIndexes.name: tracks_anchor_order_idx

finalConsumer.query: anchor kind explicitly INDEXED BY this index and reverse-walks the full priority order.

tracksIndexes.structuralRationale: Encodes paid-anchor desirability and all ordering terms beneath the unanchored slice, preventing materialize-and-sort.

tracksIndexes.name: tracks_anchor_review_idx

finalConsumer.query: Attention source lists unresolved anchor_review_json rows by track_id.

tracksIndexes.structuralRationale: Keeps a rare, operator-drained review queue off the growing blob-bearing table.

tracksIndexes.name: tracks_dismissed_idx

finalConsumer.query: dismissed lens filters dismissed_at IS NOT NULL and orders dismissed_at DESC.

tracksIndexes.structuralRationale: Indexes the rare restore-listing slice while active-catalogue composites handle the opposite null predicate.

tracksIndexes.name: tracks_demand_score_idx

finalConsumer.query: Nightly clear selects and updates rows where demand_score IS NOT NULL.

tracksIndexes.structuralRationale: Bounds demand reset and recount work to the usually small scored subset.

tracksIndexes.name: tracks_key_idx

finalConsumer.query: Mix candidates use tracks.key IN (...) harmonic prefilter.

tracksIndexes.structuralRationale: Supports public mix prefiltering and the key histogram without scanning the archive.

tracksIndexes.name: tracks_capture_priority_track_id_idx

finalConsumer.query: Pre-audio capture lens filters unscored rows with non-null capture_priority and orders priority DESC, track_id DESC.

tracksIndexes.structuralRationale: Small partial composite serves the capture-eligible queue order; nullable vendor work remains covered by the full priority index.

databaseScaleIndexes.name: due_work_ready_idx

finalConsumer.query: Ready work query filters work_kind/state and orders sort_key, subject_id.

databaseScaleIndexes.structuralRationale: Encodes the maintained ready backlog order for bounded reads and claims.

databaseScaleIndexes.name: due_work_scheduled_idx

finalConsumer.query: Promotion selects due scheduled rows by work_kind and next_due_at order.

databaseScaleIndexes.structuralRationale: Bounds scheduled-to-ready promotion to the due prefix.

databaseScaleIndexes.name: due_work_repair_idx

finalConsumer.query: Repair-marker read filters state = 'repair' and optional subject type.

databaseScaleIndexes.structuralRationale: Separates bounded repair maintenance from ready and scheduled queue paths.

databaseScaleIndexes.name: due_work_lease_idx

finalConsumer.query: Lease reaper filters leased rows by expiry and orders claim_expires_at, work_kind, subject_id.

databaseScaleIndexes.structuralRationale: Provides expiry-ordered bounded recovery of abandoned claims.

databaseScaleIndexes.name: due_work_claim_idx

finalConsumer.query: Claim result reads leased rows for one work_kind/owner/token in ready sort order.

databaseScaleIndexes.structuralRationale: Makes retried claim-result recovery a scoped ordered read rather than a leased-table scan.

databaseScaleIndexes.name: artifact_change_checkpoints_running_idx

finalConsumer.query: Checkpoint lookup constrains the complete consumer_id, stream, stream_version, phase primary key; no final query filters running checkpoints by updated_at.

databaseScaleIndexes.structuralRationale: Drop in the final contraction: every checkpoint read uses the composite primary key or a consumer-keyed join, and the running/updated_at partial order is unreachable.

databaseScaleIndexes.name: artifact_change_consumers_compaction_idx

finalConsumer.query: Compaction computes one barrier across both active and rebuilding consumers; the active-only partial index cannot serve the exact predicate.

databaseScaleIndexes.structuralRationale: Drop in the final contraction: the only barrier consumer must include rebuilding rows and scans the bounded registered-consumer control set, so the active-only partial index is unusable.

databaseScaleIndexes.name: artifact_changes_revision_idx

finalConsumer.query: INSERT ON CONFLICT(stream, stream_version, subject_type, subject_id, revision) DO NOTHING.

databaseScaleIndexes.structuralRationale: Unique retry identity is the durable idempotency boundary for immutable artifact revisions.

databaseScaleIndexes.name: artifact_changes_stream_seq_idx

finalConsumer.query: Existing-event lookup constrains stream and stream_version before subject/revision validation.

databaseScaleIndexes.structuralRationale: Provides the stream/version prefix of immutable-log lookup paths and remains distinct from the primary seq cursor.

databaseScaleIndexes.name: artifact_changes_created_seq_idx

finalConsumer.query: Compaction selects a bounded seq prefix with seq <= ? ordered by seq; the INTEGER PRIMARY KEY serves the exact shape.

databaseScaleIndexes.structuralRationale: Drop in the final contraction: no final query filters or orders by created_at, while every log page and compaction candidate read uses the seq primary key.

databaseScaleIndexes.name: artist_qualification_qualified_idx

finalConsumer.query: Qualified artist set left-joins artist_qualification with is_qualified = 1, explicitly INDEXED BY this index.

databaseScaleIndexes.structuralRationale: Indexes only the qualified projection subset in its public ordered-ID form.

databaseScaleIndexes.name: crawl_due_work_release_ready_idx

finalConsumer.query: Release lane filters ready release rows and orders storable_rank, hop, demand_rank, created_at, node_id.

databaseScaleIndexes.structuralRationale: Implements the reserved storable-release half of the two-lane crawl claim order.

databaseScaleIndexes.name: crawl_due_work_ready_idx

finalConsumer.query: General lane filters ready rows and orders breadth-first hop, demand_rank, created_at, node_id.

databaseScaleIndexes.structuralRationale: Provides the general half of the two-lane claim and the ready sentinel order.

databaseScaleIndexes.name: crawl_due_work_scheduled_idx

finalConsumer.query: Promotion selects scheduled rows due at or before now, ordered by next_due_at and node_id.

databaseScaleIndexes.structuralRationale: Bounds promotion work to the due scheduled prefix.

databaseScaleIndexes.name: crawl_due_work_repair_idx

finalConsumer.query: Repair pass explicitly INDEXED BY this index for state = 'repair' node-id selection.

databaseScaleIndexes.structuralRationale: Keeps source-repair markers on a separate bounded scan path.

databaseScaleIndexes.name: crawl_due_work_lease_idx

finalConsumer.query: Lease reaper explicitly INDEXED BY this index and orders expired lease rows by expiry/node.

databaseScaleIndexes.structuralRationale: Supports bounded expiry recovery for crawl claims.

databaseScaleIndexes.name: crawl_due_work_claim_position_idx

finalConsumer.query: Claim-result read explicitly INDEXED BY this unique index for owner/token and ORDER BY claim_position.

databaseScaleIndexes.structuralRationale: Preserves exact retry-stable merged lane ordering for one lease token.

databaseScaleIndexes.name: projection_repairs_order_idx

finalConsumer.query: Projection repair reads explicitly INDEXED BY this index and select the earliest source-epoch marker.

databaseScaleIndexes.structuralRationale: Orders source-change repair markers by projection and epoch for bounded, deterministic projection catch-up.

databaseScaleIndexes.name: artist_qualification_contributions_artist_track_idx

finalConsumer.query: Qualification maintenance reads and reconciles contribution rows by artist_id.

databaseScaleIndexes.structuralRationale: Primary key is track-first; this reverse index supports artist-oriented qualification maintenance.

databaseScaleIndexes.name: crawl_projection_repairs_order_idx

finalConsumer.query: Repair fanout explicitly INDEXED BY this index and takes earliest source epoch/type/id marker.

databaseScaleIndexes.structuralRationale: Provides deterministic source-epoch ordering for crawl projection repair fanout.

databaseScaleIndexes.name: crawl_due_work_label_slug_node_id_idx

finalConsumer.query: Label repair fanout explicitly INDEXED BY this index to enumerate affected crawl nodes.

databaseScaleIndexes.structuralRationale: Supports label-scoped fanout independently of crawl lifecycle state.

databaseScaleIndexes.name: crawl_due_work_parent_id_node_id_idx

finalConsumer.query: Artist/parent repair fanout explicitly INDEXED BY this index to enumerate dependent nodes.

databaseScaleIndexes.structuralRationale: Supports bounded parent-to-child crawl repair fanout.

databaseScaleIndexes.name: artifact_change_revisions_event_seq_idx

finalConsumer.query: Receipt insert records event_seq under a unique index, enforcing one durable revision receipt per event sequence.

databaseScaleIndexes.structuralRationale: Integrity constraint prevents two immutable revision receipts from claiming the same event.

databaseScaleIndexes.name: operation_receipts_stale_accepted_idx

finalConsumer.query: Stale-receipt reaper filters accepted rows before cutoff and orders updated_at, operation_key.

databaseScaleIndexes.structuralRationale: Indexes only in-progress receipts in exactly the bounded stale-repair order.

databaseScaleIndexes.name: operation_receipts_operation_audit_idx

finalConsumer.query: Receipt inspection and mutation reconciliation look up one operation_key through the primary key; stale repair uses operation_receipts_stale_accepted_idx.

databaseScaleIndexes.structuralRationale: Drop in the final contraction: no final audit list constrains operation_id and created_at; the only reads use the primary key or the stale-accepted partial index.

databaseScaleIndexes.name: database_admission_contenders_owner_run_idx

finalConsumer.query: Reads one contender by owner_id and run_id; enqueue uses the same pair as its ON CONFLICT target.

databaseScaleIndexes.structuralRationale: Natural retry identity supports idempotent queue insertion and exact contender recovery.

databaseScaleIndexes.name: database_admission_contenders_active_lane_idx

finalConsumer.query: Acquisition checks for conflicting active contenders before granting a lane.

databaseScaleIndexes.structuralRationale: Partial unique index is the final database concurrency backstop: at most one active row per lane.

databaseScaleIndexes.name: database_admission_contenders_queue_idx

finalConsumer.query: Acquisition selects the FIFO queued contender for a lane ordered enqueued_at_ms, contender_id.

databaseScaleIndexes.structuralRationale: Encodes fair queue order within the queued slice.

databaseScaleIndexes.name: database_admission_contenders_queue_heartbeat_idx

finalConsumer.query: Recovery deletes stale queued contenders ordered by queue_heartbeat_at_ms, contender_id.

databaseScaleIndexes.structuralRationale: Bounds queued-contender TTL cleanup to its oldest heartbeat prefix.

databaseScaleIndexes.name: database_admission_contenders_lease_idx

finalConsumer.query: Recovery deletes expired active contenders ordered by lease_expires_at_ms, lane, contender_id.

databaseScaleIndexes.structuralRationale: Bounds active-lease recovery to the expiry prefix while retaining lane/tie ordering.
